scope: Platform-specific listed stable PackageReference libraries; legacy replacements, Xamarin, tools and project templates excluded. Existing aliases and generated-control selections are preserved separately.

packages.description: This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Barcode control and more.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Calendar, Calendar Date Picker, and Calendar DateRange Picker.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Charts control and more.

The Syncfusion® .NET WinUI Chat, often known as conversational UI, provides a modern conversational chatbot experience. It is a versatile control that displays a conversation between two or more users in a fully customizable layout. Depending on the business needs, you can display messages in various formats such as text, calendar, date picker, and more.

This package contains common classes and interfaces that are used by Syncfusion® WinUI controls and WinUI Shadow component for WinUI application. Learn more: https://www.syncfusion.com/winui-controls?utm_source=nuget&utm_medium=listing
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI DockingManager control and more.

This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Color Picker, Color Palette, DropDown Color Picker, Dropdown Color Palette, Date Picker, Time Picker, NumberBox, ComboBox, Autocomplete, Rating, and Segmented Control.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Radial Gauge, and Linear Gauage.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI DataGrid, and TreeGrid.
This package provides classes and interfaces for performing scrolling operations in Syncfusion® datagrid and treeview winui project reunion controls.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI GridExport control and more.

The Syncfusion® WinUI Kanban Board is a task management control that visually organizes work across multiple stages, commonly used in project management, software or product development, personal task management, and more.

The Syncfusion® WinUI MarkdownViewer is a powerful, lightweight control that renders Markdown content with rich formatting and interactive features. It provides a seamless way to display Markdown documents in your .NET applications with customizable styling options, syntax highlighting for an enhanced reading experience.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Badge and Busy Indicator control.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Ribbon control and more.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Scheduler control and more.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI Slider, and Range Slider.
This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® WinUI TreeView control and more.
